# freshdesk_surveys (Data Source)

Every customer-satisfaction survey on the helpdesk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_surveys" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `surveys`.
- `surveys` (Attributes List) Every survey the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--surveys))

<a id="nestedatt--surveys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `surveys`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the survey is being sent.
- `created_at` (String) When the survey was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the survey.
- `header_message` (String) Message introducing the survey to the customer.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the survey.
- `language` (String) Language the survey is written in.
- `questions` (String) The survey's questions, as JSON.
- `state` (String) Whether the survey is `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE`.
- `title` (String) Title of the survey.
- `updated_at` (String) When the survey was last changed (RFC 3339).
